Game Overview

In UFO Attack, the core idea is straightforward: unleash your inner hero in UFO Attack, a fast-paced shooter where alien waves intensify with every moment. Master mouse control to aim, shoot, and dodge incoming fire. Survive relentless invasions and climb levels by hitting targets, honing quick reflexes, and sharpening strategic prowess.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in UFO Attack is easy to pick up. Unleash your inner hero in UFO Attack, a fast-paced shooter where alien waves intensify with every moment.
